description: This file contains the implementation of Prism.js, a lightweight syntax highlighter, including language definitions, hooks, and utility functions.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a syntax token with type and content, used for tokenizing and highlighting code.

methods.name: highlightAll
methods.description: Highlights all code elements on the page asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: highlightElement
methods.description: Highlights a specific code element, optionally asynchronously.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a string of code with a given grammar and language.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes input text based on a grammar, producing an array of tokens.

methods.name: Token.stringify
methods.description: Converts tokens into HTML strings with appropriate span classes.
